candidate.raw_translation: Duk mai bugawa yana samun kwallaye bakwai. Mafi girma na biyu a kowace hannun zai buɗe; idan babu hannun da yake da biyu, mafi girman darajar kwallaye zai buɗe. Haɗa ƙarshen ɗaya daga cikin kwallaye zuwa ɗayan ƙarshen da aka buɗe na layin. A cikin yanayin kwafa, karɓi kwallaye daga ajiye har sai ka iya bugawa ko kuma ya zama baƙi. A cikin yanayin ƙofar, ba da lokacin da ba za ka iya wasa ba. Taron na ƙarshe idan hannun ya zama baƙi ko kuma babu mai bugawa da zai iya motsa; mai bugawa da mafi ƙarancin kwallaye da ya rage zai lashe wasan ƙofar.
candidate.source: Each player gets seven tiles. The highest double in either hand opens; if neither hand has a double, the highest-value tile opens. Match one end of a tile to either open end of the line. In draw mode, take tiles from the stock until you can play or it is empty. In block mode, pass when you cannot play. The round ends when a hand is empty or neither player can move; the player with fewer remaining pips wins a blocked round.
